data.name: Kaleemah
data.long_meaning: Kaleemah is derived from the Arabic word 'kalaam' which means speech or talk. It is a unisex name that implies someone who is a good speaker or communicator.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Allah is referred to as 'Kaleem' or 'Al-Kaleem', meaning the one who speaks. By naming your child Kaleemah, you are invoking the divine attribute of speech and communication.
data.numerology_meaning: A nurturer, a healer, a teacher, a problem solver, a spiritual leader, a protector and a lover

in_arabic.name: كاليما
in_arabic.long_meaning: كاليما هي اسم علم مؤنث عربي يأتي من الحفظ والذكري، ويستند إلى الجذر الكلمي، الذي يعني النطق والكلام والذكاء، ويشير إلى الشخص ذي القدرة العالية على الكلام والتفكير والجدل، وقد تكون كاليما اسمًا نبوويًا في بعض الأحيان، وترمز إلى الكفاءة واليقظة والتفكير العميق في الدين والدنيا.

in_urdu.name: کالیما

in_urdu.long_meaning: کالیما ایک عربی نام ہے جو حفظ و ذکری سے ماخوذ ہے اور اس کا تعلق کلمی جڑ سے ہے جو نطق کلام اور ذکاء کے معنی میں ہے، یہ شخص کا نام ہے جو بات چیت اور فکری مہارت میں بہت ممتاز ہو یا جو ایک صاحب فکر ہو، کالیما کے بعض اوقات ایک نبی کا نام ہو جاتا ہے، یہ نام دین اور دنیا دونوں میں بڑی کفایت شعوری اور وقفہ واقفہ کا علامہ ہے۔

in_hindi.name: कालीमा
in_hindi.long_meaning: कालीमा एक अरबी नाम है जो याद रखने और स्मरण करने से मिलता-जुलता है, और इसका संबंध क़लमी जड़ से है, जिसका अर्थ बोलना, बात करना, और बुद्धिमत्ता है, यह नाम उन व्यक्ति के लिए है जो बातचीत और चिंतन में बहुत अच्छा है, या जो एक बुद्धिमान व्यक्ति है, कालीमा के कुछ मामलों में यह एक पैगंबर का नाम भी हो सकता है, और यह नाम दोनों ही दुनिया में अत्याधुनिक स्मृति और बुद्धिमानी का प्रतीक है।

in_english.name: Kaleemah
in_english.meaning: Inspirational name, wise name, skilled name
in_english.long_meaning: Kaleemah is an Arabic name that comes from the root of remembrance or preservation, and is derived from the word 'kalam', which means speech, eloquence, and wisdom. The name Kaleemah refers to a person of great eloquence and wisdom, who is able to speak with great skill and inspire others with their words. In some cases, Kaleemah can also be a name of a prophet or a wise person. The name Kaleemah symbolizes a person who is knowledgeable, wise, and skilled in their words and actions, and is able to inspire and guide others with their wisdom and eloquence.

data.cultural_impact: The name Kaleemah carries a rich cultural significance in the Islamic world, especially among the Arabic-speaking communities. It is a name that is often given to children whose parents wish them to excel in communication and eloquence. The name reflects the importance of effective communication in Islamic culture, particularly in the context of the Quran and hadith, which emphasize the importance of clear and concise speech in conveying religious teachings and guiding others towards the right path.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Kaleemah can be seen as a reminder of the importance of effective communication in one's relationship with God. The Quran describes Allah as the "Kalim", the Speaker or the One Who Speaks, emphasizing the idea that God communicates with His creation through His Word. By bearing the name Kaleemah, one can be inspired to strive for clear and precise communication with God, as well as with others, in order to deepen one's spiritual connection and understanding of the divine message. Furthermore, the name can be seen as a reminder of the role that we, as believers, play in sharing Allah's message with others, and the importance of being eloquent and persuasive in doing so.
